args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate after the latest deploy. Mitigation: rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback rolled out to all three production regions. Follow-up needed to investigate the v2.3.1 regression before re-deploying.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), failing health checks with an 18% error rate. Reviewing the release history, v2.3.0 was the most recent version that had been healthy in production.
2. **Rolled back**: checkout-api was rolled back to **v2.3.0** across all production regions — status confirmed as `rolled_out` and verified.
3. **Opened SEV2 incident**: Created **INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0") with a full summary of the failure and the mitigation, and the on-call engineer has been paged.

Follow-up recommended: investigate the v2.3.1 regression (staging also showed v2.3.1-rc as unhealthy) before attempting to re-deploy it.
